_readme: One entry per clip. Set available to true once the files exist. File names are the key plus .webm and .mp4 in video/. layout says which composition the clip is: wide (landscape scene, desktop and tablet) or portrait (phones). poster is an optional still of the same composition, as img/<poster>.webp and .jpg. Nothing else changes. Specifications: docs/concepts/asset-manifest.md

se-hero-fire-16x9.note: Salt & Ember desktop and tablet hero, 16:9, fire right, dark space left

se-hero-fire-mobile-4x5.note: Salt & Ember phone hero, composed separately in 4:5

oi-hero-window-16x9.note: Olive & Ivory desktop and tablet background scene, 16:9, dress and window right

oi-hero-portrait-4x5.note: Olive & Ivory phone hero, portrait 4:5, becomes the docking element on phones
